comment: Look and feel only; nothing here changes the simulation. Read by render/ (never loaded by headless runs' logic, though the data loader parses every file).
comment_day_colors: CanvasModulate colour by minute of day, blended linearly between stops: cool blue before dawn, warm sunrise, harsh pale noon, golden dusk, deep blue night.
comment_quality: Presets for Settings > Graphics. Each toggle can also be set on its own.
comment_wind: Fixed until the simulation has wind (prompt 4): blowing towards the north-east, in map pixels per second for drifting smoke and leaves.
